Assessment & Plan (Integrating DDx)

- Differential diagnoses (from DDx and transcript)
  - Early pregnancy complication (threatened abortion or ectopic): High likelihood; supported by recent menses timing, sexual activity, and presenting symptoms; pregnancy testing planned.
  - Urinary tract infection (UTI) / Pyelonephritis: Medium-High likelihood; supported by increased urinary frequency and feverish sensations; dysuria absent.
  - Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID): Medium likelihood; fever with lower abdominal pain in sexually active patient; risk factors present; no discharge described.
  - Corpus luteum or functional ovarian cyst: Medium likelihood; timing ~mid-luteal phase after last menses; dull lower abdominal ache; light spotting possible.
- If conflicting data arise: Not documented as conflicting in transcript and DDx.
- Plan actions
  - Arrange same-day face-to-face GP assessment.
  - Obtain pregnancy testing (urine hCG; consider serum if indicated).
  - Consider urinalysis and pelvic exam as part of the evaluation.
  - Monitor for red flags: light-headedness, dizziness, fainting, worsening pain, heavy bleeding; seek urgent care if present.
